design.unit: Complete Mercury270vA1–B20 plus the complete general conclusion271vB5–32, not only the good/bad sentence. Luna271vA1–B4 is retained contextual source with its own unresolved details, not imported as an identical trait-transfer proof.
design.mechanism: Compose a frame-qualified property reference with an explicitly chosen source frame for an attributed transmission claim. Intrinsic planetary status and status-with-associates are different propositions about the same planet.
source_argument: Mercury has sign-dependent power/fortune and a relation to Venus; retain Gemini house, Virgo exaltation and Sagittarius/Pisces no-power claims without numerical dignity scores.
270vA12–15 calls Mercury good with the good and bad with the bad, while intrinsically good. Associate domain and mixed-company aggregation are unspecified.

The Mercury-child description covers intellectual/artisanal capacities, retention/restlessness, bodily attributes, clothing/friends and an explicitly some-say tail. It is not a child-goodness observation under two known associations.

The later whole conclusion attributes planetary properties to a person according to nature/strength and qualifies single-planet attribution. It does not explicitly settle whether the earlier contextual evaluative status is among the transmitted properties.

typed_contract.source_property: QUALIFIED_PROPERTY(planet,frame,respect) -> attributed property value or UNBOUND
domain_cautions: GOOD/BAD is one provisionally aligned planetary evaluative respect, not a temperature or measured treatment benefit.
The good/bad associates are not securely identified as particular planets or people; no Saturn/Jupiter table is supplied.
Empty, mixed, changing or multiply ranked company has no output rule; do not fill it by majority, dominance or arbitrary lookup.
typed_contract.second_operation: ATTRIBUTED_TRANSFER(planet,person,episode,respect,source_frame) records the selected source value and its provenance as an attributed human disposition only under an explicit cross-domain transfer bridge. It is not literal physical transmission or a clinical effect.

two_global_variants.rule: All uses of the selected evaluative transmission channel read the INTRINSIC source frame.
two_global_variants.paired_consequence: Under the additional evaluative-channel transfer bridge, both good-company and bad-company Mercury contexts attribute GOOD to the person, while contextual Mercury status still differs.

two_global_variants.rule: All uses of that channel read the explicitly bound association frame.
two_global_variants.paired_consequence: Under the same bridge, the two contexts attribute GOOD and BAD respectively, while Mercury remains intrinsicallyGOOD in both.

design.variant_status: Neither transfer frame is selected by this RAW. The source provides the qualified Mercury predicates but not the paired child outputs. A future selected descendant must freeze one variant globally; no per-occurrence frame switching.
strongest_rivals: The transmission concerns intellectual/behavioral properties and never includes the evaluative good/bad respect. Then both proposed evaluative transfer variants add content rather than follow from source.
Intrinsic goodness and goodness-with-good may be distinct predicate senses rather than one value respect with frame arguments. The alignment is a counted assumption.
Context qualification may report a joint association rather than change anything in Mercury. No intrinsic mutation is inferred.
Moon-child instability is an explicit comparison across celestial/human domains, not proof that physical motion and habitual inconstancy are one literal trait value.
whole_unit_duties: All Mercury sign/power statements and the full child description, including attributed some-say clauses.
The full general conclusion: birth OR conception, eastern-rising strength, multiple contributions, predominance and final birth/day/hour condition.
Keep power, share, evaluative status and trait identity separate; no use of the lunar numerals to tune any model.
design.falsifier: On a future complete fixed passage with two explicitly bound association contexts and written attributed outputs in the same respect, a frozen T_NATURE must preserve its source value and T_ASSOCIATION must follow the qualified context value. A different written channel or unresolved owner leaves the paired test unavailable, not evidence for either variant. Collapsing both source frames into one unqualified GOOD/BAD field loses the already written Mercury contrast.
